resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Load-flaky test; folds into flake task

title: Make orphan fixture readiness deterministic under host load
body: Previous lead reported a #130 local gate failure in test/verdict/sandbox-orphans.test.ts: a child fixture did not announce ready within the wait; the untouched file passed a recorded retry without a code fix or pre-existing pending defect. Preserve available failure evidence and verify the mechanism rather than treating the retry as a fix. Acceptance: a deterministic readiness handshake or condition wait with bounded diagnostic deadline survives competing host work; positive live-orphan detection, termination and exit125 remain tested. No blanket retries, skips or relaxed orphan acceptance.
